rules.text: If the plotted line represents the annual mortality burden requested by the task, the y-axis tick inscriptions encode larger Count values lower on the page, and the endpoint horizontally attached to 2018 is among the lowest plotted annual markers, then 2018 is among the chart's maximum displayed annual Count values; if routing a tied maximum is permitted, the 2018 peak-follow-up option is supported.
rules.conditions: The y-axis's printed Count scale is the intended burden measure; the endpoint is attached to reporting year 2018; and the task permits routing one offered year when the displayed maximum is tied.

rules.text: If equal vertical positions on this shared y-axis encode equal annual values, then the final 2018 marker and the preceding marker at the same visible height indicate a tied displayed maximum rather than a uniquely established 2018 maximum; the chart alone does not state how to break such a tie.
rules.conditions: The points are comparable annual observations on the same Count scale, and no unshown tie-breaking instruction applies.

rules.text: If the task's phrase peak-burden requires a specific mortality measure, then the chart must establish that its plotted Count axis is the intended burden metric; the title inscription 'Year vs. Mortality rate' and y-axis inscription 'Count' use different measure terms, so the chart alone leaves that metric correspondence open.
rules.conditions: The differing title and axis terms are intended as potentially distinct measures rather than interchangeable labels, and no external dashboard definition resolves them.

added_observations.content: The rightmost marker aligned with the printed "2018" tick is visibly lower on the page than the marker halfway between the 2014 and 2016 ticks and lower than the marker halfway between the 2016 and 2018 ticks.

refinements.condition_note: If the evenly spaced annual markers between the labeled even-year ticks represent 2015 and 2017 respectively, and lower page position on the downward-increasing Count axis encodes a larger value, this closer ordering supports 2018 being strictly above those late-year values rather than tied with them.
refinements.reason: This directly addresses the previously uninspected ordering of the 2018 endpoint against the markers for 2015 and 2017, strengthening the maximum support without treating screen position alone as a decoded Count value.
